user.title: Create a role
user.description: A role is a stable logical entity that proxies a physical entity. Pick what kind of role to create.

source.title: Name and bind
source.description: Choose a name and the implementation entity this role should currently proxy. You can replace it with different hardware later without losing the role's identity.

error.source_not_found: That entity could not be found in the entity registry.
error.domain_mismatch: That entity is not in the role's domain.
error.role_on_role_rejected: A role cannot be bound to another role (direct role-on-role bindings are rejected).

replace_hardware.title: Replace hardware
replace_hardware.description: Currently bound to {current_source}. Choose the replacement implementation entity.

confirm_downgrade.title: Confirm capability downgrade
confirm_downgrade.description: The new hardware cannot deliver: {lost_capabilities}. These capabilities will be removed from the role's contract.

error.domain_mismatch: That entity is not in the role's domain.
error.role_on_role_rejected: A role cannot be bound to another role (direct role-on-role bindings are rejected).

role_unbound.title: {role_name} needs replacement hardware
role_unbound.description: The entity previously bound to {entity_id} was removed from the registry. The role has been preserved and is unavailable. Select Fix, or open the role's Configure button, to bind replacement hardware.

replace_hardware.title: [%key:component::entity_role::options::step::replace_hardware::title%]
replace_hardware.description: {title} is unbound. Choose the replacement implementation entity.

yaml_record_invalid.title: Invalid entity_role YAML record: {role_id}
yaml_record_invalid.description: This record was not applied ({reason}); every other declared role is unaffected. Fix the record in the source file and reload.
